product_one_liner.value: Owl.co provides AI that turns insurance claim documents and other records into structured, cited evidence for insurers’ claims teams.
product_one_liner.notes: Owl describes its products as turning documents, signals and records in a claim into structured, cited evidence, explicitly built for insurance. Source: https://owl.co/products

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the homepage navigation or footer, and the pricing URL did not return a pricing page. The site instead directs prospects to request a briefing. Source: https://owl.co/

named_customers.notes: The success-stories index exists, but its two customer stories anonymize the insurers rather than naming two customer organizations. The required negative result is therefore an empty list. Source: https://owl.co/success-stories

employee_band.notes: The company profile directly reports the 51–100 employee band. Source: https://fundediq.co/owl-co-owl-co-funding

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile explicitly identifies Vancouver as the headquarters city. Source: https://fundediq.co/owl-co-owl-co-funding | hq_country: The company profile explicitly identifies its headquarters as Vancouver, Canada. Source: https://fundediq.co/owl-co-owl-co-funding

founded_year.notes: The company's funding announcement explicitly states that Owl.co was founded in 2018. This primary-source statement is preferred over a conflicting LinkedIn founding year. Source: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20211103005209/en/owl.co-Secures-%2430-Million-in-Funding-to-Address-Insurance-Industrys-%2480-Billion-Fraud-Problem

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains insurance-industry, product-use and marketing explainers, rather than two engineer-authored accounts of how Owl is built. Source: https://owl.co/resources

public_docs.notes: The homepage has no documentation/help link. Although a documentation landing page lists guide titles, its destinations are placeholders rather than accessible articles, and the checked docs/help subdomains returned no pages. It therefore does not meet the multi-article public-documentation requirement. Sources: https://owl.co/ and https://owl.co/documentation

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The complete careers list has no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title. Principal Software Engineer roles involve AI work, but their titles do not meet the specified criterion; Data Quality Analyst also does not qualify. Source: https://owl.co/careers

model_provider.notes: Owl's homepage explicitly says its product uses a custom vision-language model and domain-specific knowledge. This supports the model description without inferring an external provider. Source: https://owl.co/

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Owl's security page publicly claims compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2 and ISO 27001. PCI DSS is not named in this claim. Source: https://owl.co/security | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 is explicitly named in Owl's public compliance claim at https://owl.co/security. | compliance_certs.1: ISO 27001 is explicitly named in Owl's public compliance claim at https://owl.co/security. | compliance_certs.2: HIPAA is explicitly named in Owl's public compliance claim at https://owl.co/security. | compliance_certs.3: GDPR is explicitly named in Owl's public compliance claim at https://owl.co/security.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Both the company's announcement and the current funding profile identify the latest reported round as Series B. Sources: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20211103005209/en/owl.co-Secures-%2430-Million-in-Funding-to-Address-Insurance-Industrys-%2480-Billion-Fraud-Problem and https://index.canadianai.tech/companies/owl-co | funding_date: The latest reported round was announced November 3, 2021, yielding 2021-11 in the requested format. Sources: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20211103005209/en/owl.co-Secures-%2430-Million-in-Funding-to-Address-Insurance-Industrys-%2480-Billion-Fraud-Problem and https://index.canadianai.tech/companies/owl-co | funding_amount_usd: The company announced a $30 million Series B, distinct from its cumulative funding. The current company index still lists that round as its last reported raise. Sources: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20211103005209/en/owl.co-Secures-%2430-Million-in-Funding-to-Address-Insurance-Industrys-%2480-Billion-Fraud-Problem and https://index.canadianai.tech/companies/owl-co

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile, current as of November 4, 2026, still identifies November 2021 as the last reported raise. That round predates the 18-month window. Sources: https://index.canadianai.tech/companies/owl-co and https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20211103005209/en/owl.co-Secures-%2430-Million-in-Funding-to-Address-Insurance-Industrys-%2480-Billion-Fraud-Problem

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists an Enterprise Account Executive opening, and its individual posting provides an application link. Source: https://owl.co/careers/enterprise-account-executive-559258

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog and press histories show explainers and media coverage rather than a qualifying launch within the six-month window. The latest introduction in the announcement list is dated February 25, with no year supplied; the May 9 Template Assistant article describes capabilities rather than announcing a release. Sources: https://owl.co/resources, https://owl.co/resources/template-assistant-ai-improving-insurance-document-workflows and https://www.distillintelligence.com/news/owl-co

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small leadership roster was checked in full and identifies no recent C-level or VP arrival; no departure announcement was found. Available VP of People and CTO profile dates predate the window. Some leaders lack explicit role-start dates, limiting confidence. Sources: https://owl.co/about, https://linkedin.com/in/salbayati and https://linkedin.com/in/sammerat

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Owl's account-executive job posting explicitly requires keeping records in Salesforce, establishing a visible CRM-use signal. Source: https://careers.fuse.vc/companies/owl-co-2/jobs/27041163-account-executive-director-of-enterprise-sales | crm_stack_signal.0: The sales job posting explicitly requires Salesforce recordkeeping.
